{{Top|leg}}
'''Morphometric technology''' was a form of technology capable of scanning [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and then altering the layout of specially designed ports to specifically fit the incoming ship. It was also capable of producing true to life effigies. The [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] had morphometric technology on board and during his time as [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of the station, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Master-Com]] also used it in his private quarters to entertain the wealthiest [[Gambling/Legends|gamblers]] who were visiting the station.<ref name="VSV">{{SW|url=news/viva-space-vegas-the-history-of-the-marvelous-wheel-part-2|series=Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>
